requirements.subject: advance warning system
requirements.threshold: Sign is present upstream of the closed through lane
applicability_conditions: One or more through lanes of a multilane roadway are closed
Scene has one right lane closed
requirements.source_span: The Lane(s) Closed sign (see Figure 6H-1) shall be used in advance of that point where one or more through lanes of a multi-lane roadway are closed.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect admitted CAM_FRONT temporal frames upstream of the closed lane for a Lane(s) Closed sign and retain timestamped image evidence.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only if an applicable Lane(s) Closed sign is visibly present upstream of the closed through lane; otherwise noncompliant, or indeterminate if the approach is not inspectable.

requirements.subject: W20-5 Lane Closed sign
requirements.threshold: Legend reads RIGHT LANE CLOSED for this single right-lane closure
applicability_conditions: Closed lane is the right lane
required_inputs: camera0 image of W20-5 sign legend
requirements.source_span: For a single lane closure, the Lane Closed (W20-5) sign (see Figure 6H-1) shall use the legend RIGHT (LEFT) LANE CLOSED. Where two or more adjacent lanes are closed, the W20-5a sign (see Figure 6H-1) shall use the legend XX RIGHT (LEFT) LANES CLOSED.
missing_inputs: camera0 image of W20-5 sign legend
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect CAM_FRONT frames containing the candidate W20-5 sign and read its legend at usable resolution.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only when the visible legend reads RIGHT LANE CLOSED; a different or unreadable legend is insufficient.

requirements.subject: successive advance warning signs
requirements.threshold: 100 ft between successive signs for urban low-speed conditions
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.

measurement_spec.quantity: distance between successive advance warning signs

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect CAM_FRONT frames to locate successive advance-warning signs, associate them with trajectory stations, and measure longitudinal separations.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compare each successive-sign separation with the 100 ft minimum; a separation below 100 ft is noncompliant, while absent or unmeasurable locations are indeterminate.

requirements.subject: channelizing devices in the tangent section
requirements.threshold: 2 times the posted speed in feet; at 25 mph, 50 ft maximum
applicability_conditions: Channelizing devices are used for tangent channelization
required_inputs: camera0 view of tangent channelizing devices
requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.

measurement_spec.quantity: maximum center-to-center spacing between adjacent tangent channelizing devices

thresholds.condition: tangent channelization at posted speed 25 mph

missing_inputs: camera0 view of tangent channelizing devices
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect CAM_FRONT frames to identify the tangent device run, then audit adjacent center-to-center spacing using registered scene geometry where available.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: At 25 mph the maximum tangent spacing is 50 ft; any measured adjacent spacing above 50 ft is noncompliant, otherwise the observed run complies.

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
applicability_conditions: Channelizing devices are deployed in the TTC zone
required_inputs: camera0 view of deployed channelizing devices
requirements.source_span: Channelizing devices that are no longer serviceable (see definition in Section 1C.02) shall be replaced.
missing_inputs: camera0 view of deployed channelizing devices
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect representative CAM_FRONT frames covering deployed drums and cones for damage or loss of serviceability.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only if all observed devices are serviceable; any device that is no longer serviceable is noncompliant.

requirements.subject: Particular attention
requirements.threshold: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.
requirements.source_span: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Review representative CAM_FRONT frames across the TTC zone for cleanliness, visibility, and proper positioning of channelizing devices.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only when inspected devices are clean, visible, and properly positioned throughout observable coverage; otherwise noncompliant or indeterminate for inadequate coverage.

requirements.subject: taper length L
requirements.threshold: For S of 40 mph or less, L = W*S^2/60; for S of 45 mph or more, L = W*S.
applicability_conditions: a taper using dimension L is shown or required
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-4. Formulas for Determining Taper Length. 40 mph or less: L = WS2/60. 45 mph or more: L = WS. Where L is taper length in feet, W is width of offset in feet, and S is posted speed limit, off-peak 85th-percentile speed prior to work starting, or anticipated operating speed in mph.

measurement_spec.quantity: actual taper length versus calculated L

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the applicable taper, estimate the lateral offset width, measure actual taper length from registered imagery and available geometry, and calculate L=W*S^2/60 for S=25 mph.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Require actual taper length to meet or exceed calculated L for the measured offset width; if width or endpoints cannot be established, report indeterminate.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6B.08 14: A taper having a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with channelizing devices at approximately 2
requirements.subject: A taper having a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with channelizing devices at approximately 20-foot spacing
requirements.threshold: A taper having a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with channelizing devices at approximately 20-foot spacing should be used to guide traffic into the one-lane section, and a downstream taper should be used to guide traffic back into their original lane.
requirements.source_span: A taper having a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with channelizing devices at approximately 20-foot spacing should be used to guide traffic into the one-lane section, and a downstream taper should be used to guide traffic back into their original lane.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Locate the upstream taper guiding traffic into the one-lane section, measure endpoints and device spacing with CAM_FRONT and registered geometry, and inspect for the downstream taper guiding traffic back.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Require a 50–100 ft one-lane taper with devices approximately 20 ft apart and a downstream taper guiding traffic back; failure is noncompliant, while unmeasurable geometry is indeterminate.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.03 01: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions
requirements.subject: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions,
requirements.threshold: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.source_span: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the CAM_FRONT approach sequence and identify W20-1 relative to the work space or any detour on the work road.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only if W20-1 is visibly located in advance of the work space or detour; otherwise noncompliant or indeterminate if coverage is insufficient.

requirements.subject: A merging taper
requirements.threshold: A merging taper should be long enough to enable merging drivers to have adequate advance warning and sufficient length to adjust their speeds and merge into an adjacent lane before the downstream end of the transition.
requirements.source_span: A merging taper should be long enough to enable merging drivers to have adequate advance warning and sufficient length to adjust their speeds and merge into an adjacent lane before the downstream end of the transition.

thresholds.formula_parameter: adequate advance warning and sufficient distance to adjust speed and merge

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Identify the merging transition, measure its length and relation to the downstream end using registered imagery and trajectory/lidar geometry, and inspect advance-warning context.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Compliant only when the merging taper provides adequate advance warning and sufficient distance for speed adjustment and merging; insufficient measured length or warning is noncompliant, otherwise indeterminate.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 02: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (
requirements.subject: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign
requirements.threshold: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the admitted CAM_FRONT approach sequence, identify multiple advance-warning signs if present, and determine which sign is first encountered by road users.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: When multiple advance-warning signs are needed and observed, W20-1 must be first encountered; if ordering is not observable, report indeterminate.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6B.08 12: If used, a downstream taper
requirements.subject: If used, a downstream taper
requirements.threshold: If used, a downstream taper should have a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with devices placed at a spacing of approximately 20 feet.
requirements.source_span: If used, a downstream taper should have a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with devices placed at a spacing of approximately 20 feet.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the admitted CAM_FRONT temporal sequence and accepted observations to identify any downstream taper guiding traffic back into the original lane; use trajectory and lidar registration to establish its endpoints and device locations, then measure its length and spacing.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: If a downstream taper is used, it should measure 50–100 ft with devices at approximately 20-ft spacing; a measured length outside that range or materially non-approximately-20-ft spacing is noncompliant. If no downstream taper is used, assess as not applicable; if use or geometry cannot be established, report indeterminate.
